subject: Future Tech
title: Superposition Explained
description: A quick, practical guide to Superposition Explained.

hook.text: Superposition means a quantum particle exists in multiple states simultaneously until it is measured.

buildup.text: Imagine flipping a coin that stays airborne forever, being heads and tails at the same time.

discovery.text: Mathematically, a qubit in superposition is described by two complex numbers whose squares sum to one.

twist.text: Measurement destroys superposition. The qubit snaps to 0 or 1, and the other possibility vanishes forever.

climax.text: Algorithms exploit superposition by running calculations on all states at once before the final measurement.

punchline.text: Superposition is power that vanishes when watched.

quiz.question: What happens to superposition when a qubit is measured?
options: It collapses to a single state
